usages.explain: Used when the event described in the latter part of the sentence is more important or at a higher level, or has a special significance compared to the event described in the first part.

examples.content: 余人はいざ知らず僕だけはかまわぬ。
examples.transcription: よにんはいざしらずぼくだけはかまわぬ。
examples.mean: The rest of us don't know about it, but I don't care.

examples.content: 両親はいざしらず、弟の結婚を許すわけにはいかない。
examples.transcription: りょうしんはいざしらず、おとうとのけっこんをゆるすわけにはいかない。
examples.mean: My parents can't allow my younger brother to get married without their knowledge.

usages.synopsis: N+は+いざしらず（いざ知らず）

title: いざしらず => I don't know about … but; it may be possible for … but ~ ...
